caption: The drawing is a top-down view of a formal garden layout with a symmetrical, rectangular composition. The garden is bordered by a brown fence or wall and has a main entrance at the bottom center, marked by a small brown-roofed white gatehouse. Along the top edge, there are two structures: a central, white building with a brown roof and a smaller structure with a tall, pointed brown roof to the right. The northern section contains two symmetrical orchards or groves, each with evenly spaced green trees, and separated by a green-bordered path. Below this, there are four main rectangular sections: the top two have geometric parterre designs with green lines and circles, with yellow details at the centers and corners; the lower two contain rectangular planting beds, also arranged with green and yellow lines and bordered by green paths and circular features at the corners. The bottom corners of the garden each contain two green-bordered, diagonal-striped beds with circular features at the intersections, and at the very bottom center is another geometric parterre, with a circular green and yellow motif. The background areas between garden beds are light brown, while the garden pathways and parterre borders are marked in green. The color palette consists mainly of shades of green, brown, yellow, and white.
title: West India Company's Gardens
